name: smwgraphics-omh-lanthwomp
title: ~omh~ - Lanthwomp
description:
What happens if you mix a japanese festival lantern with a thwomp face? It becomes a Lanthwomp.

It is a bit more polished version of the funny sprite seen in the level fireworks festival 50xx - looking for the past glory, from ~omh~.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
